name: @fireback/react-sdk
description: Fireback's generated SDK and admin-panel feature modules (selfservice, manage, messaging, ...). Shared hooks and common UI components live in the sibling @fireback/react-ui package instead - this depends on that, not the other way around. Ships as raw TS/TSX source (no build step) - consumers resolve/transpile it with their own bundler, same as when this folder was copy-pasted directly into a project.
